about: The delay of the native nodes (scripts/delay-native/run.mjs: the graph the app played before the core of the chain) rendered in an OfflineAudioContext. A scene: its rate, its frames, the params of the knobs at 0 (time and pan seconds, mode 1 ping-pong), the changes of them at a frame (a multiple of 128: they glide as the app set them), the input of scenes.mjs (`input`: its kind), the output as base64 of f32 (left, right).
